title: RESET APP
caption:
Permanently clears this device’s wallet data
and returns you to onboarding.
bullet1: All seeds on this device are deleted
bullet2: Nostr identity (nsec) is forgotten from Keystore
bullet3: Without your own nsec backup, any Nostr relay package becomes unrecoverable
bullet4: Local encrypted backup package is kept on this device (needs nsec + passphrase to open)
bullet5: Activity history and wallet list are wiped
bullet6: Transaction notes stay in the local database until you uninstall the app
bullet7: You will land on the create / restore onboarding screen
bullet8: Passkey link on this device is cleared — Continue with passkey asks your password manager to pick an existing key (never silent create)
bullet9: Passkey child index map (active + archived) is kept for rematerialize from the same PRF
bullet10: Any wallets not in the passkey tree will be removed (restore them from a Nostr / home backup)
hint:
This cannot be undone without a seed, passkey, or
encrypted package plus nsec and passphrase.
